name: rag-fact-check
description: AI apps: check whether a source supports, contradicts or never mentions a generated claim.

verdict.instructions: Compare `claim` with `source`. What does `source` say about `claim`?

criteria.supported: `source` states this, possibly in different words.
criteria.contradicted: `source` states something incompatible with `claim`, such as a different number, scope or condition.
